newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK Cheung Kong, Hutchison accept site premium - paper.
newsitem.headline: HK Cheung Kong, Hutchison accept site premium - paper.

text.p: Cheung Kong (Holdings) Ltd and associate Hutchison Whampoa Ltd have agreed to pay a land premium of HK$3.4 billion for a reclamation site in Hung Hom, the Hong Kong Economic Journal said on Thursday.
The premium was reduced from the original HK$4.4 billion, the Hong Kong Economic Journal quoted unidentified property sources as saying.

A company, equally owned by Cheung Kong and Hutchison, entered into a joint venture agreement with the Kowloon-Canton Railway Corp (KCRC) last December for the joint develoment of a commercial complex on the site.
Cheung Kong and Hutchison are understood to be paying the land premium.
Officials of the companies were not available for comment and a government official involved in the deal declined to comment.
